# Partition Field Count Limits (DATE vs CUSTOM) — facts

> Source-anchored units about Partition Field Count Limits (DATE vs CUSTOM): 4 across 3 sources. Each line ends in the URL and anchor it came from; `keywords:` names the lexicon terms that matched.

<!-- generated by llms-concept-abstractor v1.4.1 · generated 2026-10-30 · 4 units · 3 sources · rights: quote -->

## How it works

- [statement] When creating a DATE archive through the API or Terraform, include criteria.dateField (Terraform date_field) in the partition-field list. It consumes one of the three available slots. (high confidence) (verified as of 2024-11-13) — https://www.mongodb.com/docs/api/doc/atlas-admin-api-v2/2024-11-13/operation/operation-getgroupclusteronlinearchive · keywords: Partition Field Count Limits (DATE vs CUSTOM) · also: https://www.mongodb.com/docs/atlas/online-archive/configure-online-archive-standard.md, https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mongodb/terraform-provider-mongodbatlas/master/docs/resources/online_archive.md

## Facts and statements

- [statement] For criteria.type DATE, the documented maximum is three partition fields total, including the required archival date field; at most two other fields can be added. (high confidence) (verified as of 2024-11-13) — https://www.mongodb.com/docs/api/doc/atlas-admin-api-v2/2024-11-13/operation/operation-getgroupclusteronlinearchive · keywords: Partition Field Count Limits (DATE vs CUSTOM) · also: https://www.mongodb.com/docs/atlas/online-archive/configure-online-archive-standard.md, https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mongodb/terraform-provider-mongodbatlas/master/docs/resources/online_archive.md, https://www.pulumi.com/registry/packages/mongodbatlas%403.x/api-docs/onlinearchive/
- [statement] For criteria.type CUSTOM, the documented maximum is two partition fields total. The DATE three-field allowance is conditional on DATE criteria, not a general allowance for every archive. (high confidence) (verified as of 2024-11-13) — https://www.mongodb.com/docs/api/doc/atlas-admin-api-v2/2024-11-13/operation/operation-getgroupclusteronlinearchive · keywords: Partition Field Count Limits (DATE vs CUSTOM) · also: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mongodb/terraform-provider-mongodbatlas/master/docs/resources/online_archive.md, https://www.pulumi.com/registry/packages/mongodbatlas%403.x/api-docs/onlinearchive/
- [statement] An Online Archive must have at least one partition field; the documented maxima are not a requirement to populate every available field slot. (high confidence) (verified as of 2024-11-13) — https://www.mongodb.com/docs/api/doc/atlas-admin-api-v2/2024-11-13/operation/operation-getgroupclusteronlinearchive · keywords: Partition Field Count Limits (DATE vs CUSTOM) · also: https://www.mongodb.com/docs/atlas/online-archive/configure-online-archive-standard.md
